text: Pip the gull flies over the island every morning, mostly to be seen flying.
He saw the wreck. He saw Gus on the stairs. And on the north rocks, he saw a coat.
A yellow coat, hood up, facing the lighthouse. Standing where no boat could land.
Pip screamed it to the whole harbour. Gulls are not taken seriously.
By the time Gus looked up… the rocks were empty.
But the coat had left something behind.
